articles.summary: TOANO, Va., April 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - CF Financial Corporation (the Corporation) (NASDAQ: CFFI), the holding company for CF Bank, today reported consolidated net income of $6.8 million for the first quarter of 2026 compared to $5.4 million for the first quarter of 2025.
